subject: Is the current review question and actual content immediately understandable, and are left/right navigation plus automatic progression simple without a question list?
acceptanceCriteria: The current question, ordinal, and actual reviewed content are immediately understandable without inspecting machine evidence.
Left/right arrow navigation is obvious and usable without a sidebar, abbreviated-question list, or scrolling.
Accept/Reject progression to the next undecided item is understandable.
waiverPolicy: No implicit waiver. M038 changes the human-review UI itself, so these blocking UX/visual items require repository-user approval.
